alt.description: Localized alt text for the cover: describes the art and transcribes the title, cover text and any lettering.

label.description: Name distinguishing this cover from others on the chapter (e.g. 'Cover A', 'Cover B', '1:25 Incentive').

images.description: Localized final images for this cover.

chapter.description: AT-URI of the parent chapter. Use the DID form (at://did:...), not a handle.

credits.description: The credits for the people who worked on this cover, when they differ from the chapter's.

versions.description: Other versions of the cover's artwork, such as production stages or alternate treatments. AppViews may let readers peel back stages or switch between versions.

aspectRatio.description: The aspect ratio of the cover.

main.description: A cover for a chapter. A chapter may have several covers: a primary cover and any number of variants.
